title: Unifying ICL, SFT, KL-Regularized RL Through a Bayesian Lens
abstract: arXiv:2609.05111v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models are now trained and evaluated under a diverse set of paradigms: supervised fine-tuning (SFT), few-shot in-context learning (ICL), KL-regularized RLHF/RLVR, on-policy distillation (OPD), and test-time reasoning with search and chain-of-thought. These methods are often discussed as fundamentally different, and recent empirical results--such as the mixed impact of few-shot prompting on RL-tuned reasoning models--can appear puzzling. This note develops a Bayesian perspective that puts these procedures on the same footing. At the core is a two-step template: (i) construct a (generalized) Bayes or Gibbs posterior q* over outputs or actions given a context, using a prior/reference model and a utility signal (log-likelihood, reward, or advantage); and (ii) approximate q* by a forward-KL projection onto a parametric family, either in-weights (SFT/RL) or in-context (ICL). translated_title: 通过贝叶斯视角统一上下文学习（ICL）、监督微调（SFT）与KL正则化强化学习
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型目前在多种不同的范式下进行训练和评估：监督微调（SFT）、少样本上下文学习（ICL）、KL正则化的RLHF/RLVR、在线策略蒸馏（OPD），以及结合搜索和思维链的测试时推理。这些方法通常被认为是本质上不同的，而近期的实证结果——例如少样本提示对RL调优推理模型的混合影响——可能显得令人困惑。本笔记发展了一种贝叶斯视角，将这些方法置于同一框架之下。其核心是一个两步模板：（i）使用先验/参考模型和效用信号（对数似然、奖励或优势函数），在给定上下文的条件下构建关于输出或动作的（广义）贝叶斯或Gibbs后验q*；（ii）通过前向KL投影将q*近似到某个参数化族上，可以是在权重中（SFT/RL）或在上下文中（ICL）。第一部分将少样本ICL和SFT形式化为摊销的（后验近似）……
tldr: 本文提出一个统一的贝叶斯框架，将ICL、SFT、KL正则化RL等多种大模型训练范式归结为“构建广义贝叶斯/Gibbs后验，再用前向KL投影进行近似”的同一两步模板。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a unified Bayesian framework that casts ICL, SFT, and KL-regularized RL into a common two-step template: constructing a generalized Bayes/Gibbs posterior and approximating it via forward-KL projection.
